items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: No prose line names update-step, --restore or a run-state writer (fails-on-old test); push-tag carries F1a/F1b/F4; public tag-check wrapper with a boundary test; deltas for every changed frozen file; the open points are recorded in FINDINGS D39-D43.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: push-tag refuses a missing release record, event record, mode, a non-trunk name, an unreadable merge state and a moved trunk; each refusal has a reason code and a test.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The branch name is read from disk, checked against the trunk list and pushed as refs/heads/<name> after --end-of-options; the hook is blind to this push, so the CLI repeats its record rule (D39).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: In-process tests with the injected runner for every refusal and for the CLI dispatch, a real-git script test, and all 73 scenarios replayed through the CLI driver.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One git diff and, off the trunk, one fetch per call; no loops.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New lib module release_push.py under 60 lines; on_base extracted from the PR check so verify and push share one ancestry test.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: push-tag reads release_run.json (written by release_runstate.patch) and release_state.json (written by release_commit.write_state) through their own readers; the tag-check script and the shared verifier meet at check_release_tag, tested through the script on real git.
